weighting_check.conclusion: BF16 route-weight rounding is not sufficient cause of max_abs128

kernel_contract_difference: Triton IQ2_XXS/Q2_K fused path dequantizes quant tiles to activation dtype BF16 before product/accumulation; independent gguf-py reference dequantizes weights to FP32 and performs explicit FP32 matmul before BF16 boundaries.
interpretation: max_abs128 is a shared M4/M8 baseline-vs-reference discrepancy amplified from small gate/up differences; it is one BF16 ULP at the final ~17k scale. This explains the observed absolute maximum without classifying M8 as a regression. It does not by itself certify all fused-kernel numerical error.
